summary: Enhance your leadership skills with this Professional Leadership and Management Training Course. Gain essential tools for effective team management and success.
lede: Leadership and management training helps professionals responsible for team performance and cross-functional projects turn organizational priorities into clear daily work. Participants practise structuring delegation with RACI, aligning team objectives and performance measures, and coaching employees with the GROW model, while building stakeholder communication plans and a measurable leadership action plan.
audienceIntro: This program is structured for professionals who are responsible for driving team performance, managing cross-functional projects, and translating organizational strategy into daily execution.
modules: Foundations of Professional Leadership and Management
Integration: Building Your Leadership Operating System
prerequisites: Participants should have a minimum of 1-3 years of professional experience, with current or anticipated responsibilities in team leadership, project management, or departmental oversight. No prior formal management training is required, but a working knowledge of your organization's strategic goals and performance evaluation processes is highly recommended. Participants should bring a laptop to access digital templates and participate in dashboard exercises.
